dispositions.topic_text: Execution paths required to test the clock read-count invariant
dispositions.what: The witness of INV-13 also covers refusals before the clock reading (none), refusals after it (one) and a replayed mark (one).

dispositions.topic_text: Lexical grammar, numeric ranges, and invalid-offset handling for camera timestamps
dispositions.what: An offset is usable with hours up to 14 and minutes up to 59. Any other offset counts as absent, so the time is read in the configured time zone, as the prototype does.

dispositions.topic_text: Behavior when the photo-folder root cannot be listed
dispositions.what: A photo folder that cannot be listed is refused with folder_unavailable, like a subfolder that cannot be listed.

dispositions.topic_text: Refusal precedence between an unconfirmed connection and an unavailable folder
dispositions.what: The connection is checked before the photo folder in scan as in placement, so an unconfirmed connection answers connection_not_confirmed.

dispositions.topic_text: Time-zone database version and behavior when Europe/Madrid rules are unavailable
dispositions.what: The deployment image carries the time zone database, and the service does not start when the configured zone is unavailable.

dispositions.topic_text: Which OSV vulnerability records count for installed versions
dispositions.what: How the vulnerability check treats withdrawn records and conflicting affected-version data.

dispositions.topic_text: Whether the resolved invoice subfolder must remain strictly inside the resolved root
dispositions.reason: The deliverer never reads the invoice folder. The Cabinet Inbox checks that folder when it moves to this connection, as a separate step (R0-09).
